elements.element: Vendor must defend Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims alleging that the services or deliverables infringe or misappropriate intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must defend Client and its affiliates against third-party claims alleging that the Interface, related software, Hosting Services, or Support Services infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right.

elements.element: Vendor must indemnify Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims alleging that the services or deliverables infringe or misappropriate intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: The same provision expressly requires TrueLink to indemnify Client and its affiliates for the specified third-party IP claims.

elements.element: Vendor must defend Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims arising from Vendor's breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: The added language requires TrueLink to defend Client and its affiliates against third-party claims arising out of TrueLink's breach of applicable law.

elements.element: Vendor must indemnify Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims arising from Vendor's breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: The added language requires TrueLink to indemnify Client and its affiliates against such claims.

elements.element: Vendor must defend Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims arising from a data breach caused by Vendor.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must defend against third-party claims arising from unauthorized access to, use, or disclosure caused by TrueLink of Client Content, Credit Data, or other Client, affiliate, or customer data processed by TrueLink.

elements.element: Vendor must indemnify Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims arising from a data breach caused by Vendor.
elements.evidence: The same data-security trigger is covered by TrueLink's express indemnification duty.

elements.element: Vendor must defend Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims arising from Vendor's gross negligence or willful misconduct.
elements.evidence: The added clause expressly covers third-party claims arising out of TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct and imposes a defense duty.

elements.element: Vendor must indemnify Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims arising from Vendor's gross negligence or willful misconduct.
elements.evidence: The added clause expressly imposes indemnification for this category of third-party claims.

elements.element: Customer must give Vendor prompt notice of an indemnified claim.
elements.evidence: Client must give TrueLink prompt written notice of any claim indemnified under the section.

elements.element: Vendor must control the defense of an indemnified claim.
elements.evidence: The clause states that TrueLink shall have control of the defense.

elements.element: Vendor must control the settlement of an indemnified claim.
elements.evidence: The clause states that TrueLink shall have control of settlement.

elements.element: Customer must provide reasonable cooperation in the defense of an indemnified claim.
elements.evidence: Client is expressly required to provide reasonable cooperation in the defense.

elements.element: Any content-based Customer indemnity must be limited to Customer-provided content.
elements.evidence: Client's content-based indemnity is limited to claims arising out of or relating to Client Content, including content posted through Client's site or access.

elements.element: Any legal-compliance-based Customer indemnity must be limited to Customer's own breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: The only legal-compliance trigger is Client's breach of an applicable state or federal law, rule, or regulation.

elements.element: Customer must have no indemnity triggers other than Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: The rendered Client indemnity contains only the Client Content and Client breach-of-law triggers; the former breach-of-agreement, system-agreement, website, and product-injury triggers were removed.

elements.element: Vendor must indemnify Customer against third-party IP infringement or misappropriation claims concerning the services or deliverables.
elements.evidence: TrueLink expressly indemnifies Client against third-party claims alleging that the Interface, related software, Hosting Services, or Support Services infringe or misappropriate intellectual property rights.

elements.element: The Vendor IP indemnity must exclude claims caused by Customer modifications.
elements.evidence: No Customer-modification exclusion appears. The possibility of Customer modifications is not demonstrably absent, so the conditional exclusion is required.

elements.element: The Vendor IP indemnity must exclude claims caused by combinations with items not supplied or approved by Vendor.
elements.evidence: No combination exclusion appears. The possibility of such combinations is not demonstrably absent.

elements.element: The Vendor IP indemnity must exclude claims resulting from Vendor's compliance with Customer specifications.
elements.evidence: No Customer-specifications exclusion appears, and the condition cannot be treated as demonstrably absent.

elements.element: The IP-infringement remedies must include procuring the right for Customer to continue using the affected services or deliverables.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no obligation or option to procure continued usage rights.

elements.element: The IP-infringement remedies must include modifying the affected services or deliverables to make them non-infringing.
elements.evidence: No modification remedy is included.

elements.element: The IP-infringement remedies must include replacing the affected services or deliverables with non-infringing substitutes.
elements.evidence: No replacement remedy is included.

elements.element: The IP-infringement remedies must include a refund if continued use cannot be enabled through the other stated remedies.
elements.evidence: No refund remedy is included.

elements.element: Vendor's indemnification liability must be subject to a super-cap equal to three times annual fees.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no 3× annual-fees cap or other indemnification super-cap.

result.reason: The operative redline fully reaches the preferred position: it adds the required Vendor defense and indemnity triggers and procedure and narrows Client's indemnity to Client Content and Client's breach of law. The fallback is not independently complete because all specified IP exclusions, remedies, and the 3× annual-fees super-cap are absent. The changes preserve unrelated substantive terms, but they are not minimal because the unrelated Credit Data definition was unnecessarily moved ahead of the indemnity provisions. Drafting quality is reduced by the resulting nonsequential d/a/b structure, the duplicated phrase 'hold Client harmless ... harmless,' and overlap between the existing broad TrueLink indemnity and the new specific indemnity.
